items.title: Return completed claim form and wildlife-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: This is a contractual deadline set by a private insurer (no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies, since it is not an authority letter). The period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens', i.e. from the letter's own date, 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 22.11.2026. The letter defines Werktage itself as Monday–Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting 13 such Werktage from 22.11.2026 forward, skipping the Sundays 22.11, 29.11 and 06.12.2026 (no public holidays fall in this window in either NW or HE), lands on Monday 07.12.2026. The insurer's seat is in Wiesbaden (Hessen), so Hessen's holiday calendar governs where the deadline is met, but there is no holiday difference in this period versus NRW. Final day: 07.12.2026.
